subject.title: feat(ledger): add immutable action history core

question: Should the proposed event schema, identity model, privacy rules, filesystem trust model, projection behavior, and shard layout become ClawSweeper’s permanent v1 action-history contract?
rationale: The remaining choice is a long-lived product, compatibility, and security commitment; the patch and tests cannot determine maintainer intent about the exact permanent contract.

options.title: Adopt the hardened v1
options.body: Accept the current core contract and require the stacked instrumentation to preserve existing projections during a staged rollout.

options.title: Narrow v1 first
options.body: Limit initial event families and compatibility promises to what the first production writers require, expanding later without breaking v1.

options.title: Defer the ledger stack
options.body: Pause the core and dependent instrumentation until a smaller workflow-specific implementation proves the architecture.

recommendation.title: Adopt the hardened v1
recommendation.body: Accept the current core contract and require the stacked instrumentation to preserve existing projections during a staged rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available owner for both this proposal and the current durable-state machinery it extends.
